Places in the neighbourhood

Listen once. What is the situation?

Press Listen. The choices below unlock once the recording finishes.
Written support (not scored)

Hello. My name is Layla. I live near the town centre. There is a big supermarket near my home. The pharmacy is next to the hospital. My children go to the school next to the mosque. The bank is across from the supermarket. There is a small park opposite the school. The bus stop is near the park. I feel happy in my neighbourhood.

The exact wording of the recording has not been independently checked against this text.
